title: ClientGuard
description: Client and matter management for law firms and financial-service providers.

title: A clearer path from intake to closeout
description: Gather parties and client details before a matter opens; review potential conflicts; manage matter work; close with billing and retention review.

title: Client and matter work, one view
description: Create and search records, drill into details, follow activity, and export selected or all matters as PDFs.

title: Intake that keeps professional judgment in the loop
description: Capture parties and details, configure onboarding checks, flag conflicts for review, and require clearance before opening a matter.

title: Billing drafts with saved terms and review
description: Save matter billing terms, record time, prepare scheduled draft bills, and review before accounting sync.

title: Documents become proposed work—not automatic tasks
description: Store private documents and confirm source-backed task and calendar suggestions before they reach the planner.

title: Client updates, drafted from real matter activity
description: Schedule activity-based update drafts and edit, review, publish, or explicitly send them.

title: A focused portal for clients
description: Clients see explicitly shared matters, approved updates, messages, requests, and document uploads; firm notes and drafts remain private.

title: Engagement letters with signature tracking
description: Draft from scope and billing terms, send through DocuSign, track completion, and attach the signed PDF.

title: Client-money records with approvals and reconciliation
description: Matter-specific ledger entries, approvals, manual or CSV reconciliation, exceptions, and jurisdiction settings.

title: Connect your firm's approved tools
description: Connect Google, Microsoft, Xero, and QuickBooks through firm-owned accounts; sync only confirmed or reviewed work.

title: Audit, retention, and legal-hold controls
description: Audit sensitive activity, set retention periods, search and export activity, and apply or release legal holds.

title: Close matters; make return work easier
description: Complete final billing, handover, retention review, and re-engagement follow-ups.

title: Firm operations reporting—and a transparent roadmap
description: Current operations reports plus clearly labeled requested features that are not yet available.

title: See what fits your firm
description: Free for one client and one matter; AU$15 per client per month for two or more clients; explore the public site.
